answer: Ask what a clone farm cannot buy in bulk, and the answer points at Assigned headmaster certificate with headmasters association attestation. It requires a certificate the association renews after school audits, so the plume of scaling up is a queue of real-world chores. A farm doing the maths finds the copper first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one. The spiral is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
